_readme: WORKED EXAMPLE — Littleton Regional Hospital's own answers, kept in the
template so a fork can see the SHAPE of a complete answer sheet.
DO NOT copy this file over site.config.json and go live. Every clinical
value here is specific to LRH's assay, formulary, equipment and transfer
agreements. Copying it would give your department a manual that is
confidently, quietly wrong about itself — which is worse than an obviously
blank one, because nobody re-checks a screen that looks finished.
Legitimate uses: reading it alongside ONBOARDING.md to see what a real
answer looks like, and running `node verify_localization.mjs --config
site.config.lrh.json` to prove the build works end to end when fully

bloodBank.how: Any attending physician may activate MTP in an emergent situation; the first three activation criteria are LRH policy.

security.how: ask Security to restrict the ED to one controlled entrance
security.note: LRH has no dedicated in-house ED security officer overnight — confirm who is actually available on your shift before you need them.

trop.assayName: hs-cTn, reported in ng/L — confirm the platform with your lab

formulary.strokeLytic: tenecteplase (TNK) 0.25 mg/kg IV bolus, max 25 mg
formulary.thrombectomyTrigger: NIHSS ≥6 or FAST-ED ≥4 → CTA and thrombectomy call
formulary.reversalAgents: 4F-PCC, vitamin K, idarucizumab, andexanet alfa — confirm what is physically stocked
formulary.mtpRatio: 1:1:1 where platelets are available; platelets often not on site

physical.lungIsolation: Neither a bronchial blocker nor a double-lumen tube is stocked — the large single-lumen ETT is the isolation technique
physical.balloonTamponadeTube: Sengstaken-Blakemore (3-lumen, dual balloon); the Minnesota tube is not stocked
physical.simRoom: Resus bay or the education room — a table the whole team can stand around

policy.stroke: Littleton Regional Hospital Stroke Alert Role-Based Checklist (MD/PA/APRN)
policy.ich: Littleton Regional Hospital Intracranial Hemorrhage (ICH) Checklist
policy.mtp: Littleton Regional Healthcare, Massive Transfusion Protocol policy (effective 07/01/2026; document owner: Chief Medical Officer)
policy.statusEpilepticus: Littleton Regional Hospital Status Epilepticus Checklist
policy.asthma: Littleton Regional Hospital Status Asthmaticus Management Checklist
policy.angioedema: Littleton Regional Hospital Angioedema Management Checklist
policy.tracheostomy: Littleton Regional Hospital "Granular Rubric for Evaluating a Tracheostomy Emergency"
policy.pedsOrderSet: LRH Pediatric General PowerPlan (Cerner order set)
policy.stemiActivation: No on-site cath lab — STEMI is transferred out via the transfer center; confirm who is paged and the current process
